Browser-option merge gap tracked in story actionpack-omissions-from-wide-verify.

Per-entry verified (RFC 0032 wide-entry verification): Rails driver.rb:10-25 pops the name with `@options.delete(:name)`; trails driver.ts:47-55 uses the JS `delete opts.name` operator on a spread copy.

Missing construction, not a constructor idiom: Rails' `initialize` (actionpack/lib/action_dispatch/system_testing/driver.rb:10-25) builds `@browser = Browser.new(options[:using])` on the `:selenium` branch. The port (system-testing/driver.ts:47-55) stores `options.using` raw; `Browser` has no trails counterpart. Not tracked by a story: actionpack is outside the project's stated focus (activerecord and its dependencies), which is why the convergence story filed for this row was closed as out of scope.
